set(PLATFORM_LIST rt1170 rt700)
set(OPENVG_PLATFORM "rt1170" CACHE STRING "Compile OpenVG for this platform.")
set_property(CACHE OPENVG_PLATFORM PROPERTY STRINGS ${PLATFORM_LIST})
if(NOT OPENVG_PLATFORM IN_LIST PLATFORM_LIST)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OPENVG_PLATFORM must be one of ${PLATFORM_LIST}")
endif()

add_subdirectory(${OPENVG_PLATFORM})
